description: The deep blue silhouette of Pedernal  contrasts with a sky that glows white just above the landscape and transitions to blue near the top of the image. A small white mark at the top of the image denotes a moon in the sky. The work is painted with loose brushwork on a piece of canvas, and the edges of the canvas are visible.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Pedernal)
